title: Sauti za Busara: Zanzibar's Music Festival
excerpt: Sauti za Busara is a music festival in Stone Town, celebrating African music. When it takes place and what to expect.
body:
## What is it?

Sauti za Busara ("sounds of wisdom") is a festival of African music held in Stone Town, usually in February.

## Music

Artists from Tanzania, East Africa and the rest of the continent, from traditional to modern.

## Location

Traditionally at the Old Fort in Stone Town.

## Check dates

Dates and editions vary. Check the official website.

## Accommodation

Book early for Stone Town during the festival.

See [Stone Town](/blog/stone-town-walking-guide/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
